title: Successor step for the summand filtration
statement: Let X be locally Noetherian, i : Z → X a closed immersion with integral source, and I a nonzero coherent ideal on Z. If the pushforward of its r-fold direct sum has a coherent integral-ideal filtration [def-weil-pbc-coherent-integral-filtration], then the pushforward of its (r+1)-fold direct sum has one.

source.place: Tag 01YF, final paragraph of lemma-coherent-filter; split-sum successor step

proof.text: Apply finite pushforward coherence to the summand, obtain the finite-sum comparison isomorphism, and apply the split-biproduct filtration extension theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentIntegralFiltration_ideal_sum_succ
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral Z]
    (r : ℕ) (I : Z.IdealSheafData) (hne : I ≠ ⊥)
    (hI : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace I.toModules)
    (hprev : HasCoherentIntegralFiltration
      ((pushforward i).obj (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules))) :
    HasCoherentIntegralFiltration
      ((pushforward i).obj (∐ fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => I.toModules))
